label: Injury
narasi_id: Siemens menerima laporan bahwa terjadi kejadian tidak diinginkan saat mengoperasikan sistem MR MAGNETOM Vida. Disebutkan bahwa seorang pasien mengalami luka bakar, tetapi tidak ada informasi rinci tentang luka bakar maupun perawatan medisnya. Siemens telah meminta informasi tambahan untuk menyelidiki kejadian tersebut, tetapi hingga kini pelanggan belum menanggapi. Karena itu, kejadian ini dilaporkan sebagai langkah kehati-hatian.
event_text: IT WAS REPORTED TO SIEMENS THAT AN ADVERSE EVENT OCCURRED WHILE OPERATING THE MAGNETOM VIDA MR SYSTEM. IT WAS STATED THAT A PATIENT RECEIVED A BURN, ALTHOUGH NO DETAILED INFORMATION ABOUT THE BURN OR MEDICAL TREATMENT IS AVAILABLE. SIEMENS HAS REQUESTED ADDITIONAL INFORMATION TO CONDUCT AN INVESTIGATION OF THE REPORTED EVENT; HOWEVER, THE CUSTOMER HAS NOT RESPONDED TO THIS DATE. THEREFORE, THIS EVENT IS BEING REPORTED IN THE ABUNDANCE OF CAUTION.

label: Malfunction
narasi_id: Dilaporkan bahwa seorang pasien mengalami luka bakar yang menimbulkan lepuh kecil di lengannya selama pemindaian. Lengan pasien menyentuh dinding bore selama pemindaian. Tidak ada bukti bahwa sistem MR mengalami malfungsi. Pihak fasilitas tidak memakai bantalan pasien untuk mencegah kontak dengan dinding bore, sebagaimana diatur dalam manual operator "Working Safely", 2381696.
event_text: IT WAS REPORTED THAT A PT SUSTAINED A BURN RESULTING IN SMALL BLISTERS TO THEIR ARM DURING A SCAN. THE PT'S ARM WAS IN CONTACT WITH THE BORE WALL DURING THE SCAN. THERE IS NO EVIDENCE THAT THE MR SYSTEM MALFUNCTIONED. THE SITE FAILED TO USE PT PADDING TO PREVENT PT CONTACT WITH THE BORE WALL AS DEFINED IN THE WORKING SAFELY OPERATOR MANUAL, 2381696.

narasi_id: Pasien datang untuk pemindaian MRI dan menyatakan tidak memiliki implan. Beberapa minggu kemudian pasien kembali untuk pemindaian kedua, tetapi kali ini dilaporkan tidak mampu menjawab pertanyaan skrining. Karena itu, radiolog melakukan skrining menggunakan film. Pada saat itulah ditemukan lead (kabel elektroda) yang tertinggal di tubuh. ID laporan keselamatan FDA # (B)(4).
event_text: PATIENT CAME FOR MRI SCAN AND REPORTED TO HAVE NO IMPLANTS. PATIENT CAME BACK WEEKS LATER FOR A SECOND SCAN BUT THIS TIME WAS REPORTED TO NOT BE ABLE TO ANSWER SCREENING QUESTIONS. DUE TO THIS A SCREENING BY THE RADIOLOGIST, USING FILMS WAS CONDUCTED TO SCREEN THAT PATIENT. IT WAS DURING THIS TIME THAT THE RETAINED LEADS WERE FOUND. FDA SAFETY REPORT ID # (B)(4).

narasi_id: Troli linen dari baja dibawa terlalu dekat ke MRI. Petugas tidak ingat apakah sistem FerroGuard berbunyi atau tidak. Troli linen tertarik dan menempel pada magnet. label: Injury
narasi_id: Dilaporkan terjadi cedera serius selama operasi normal dan pemosisian pasien di ruang MAGNETOM Aera. Pasien didampingi seorang pria yang membawa pistol berisi peluru dan satu magasin cadangan saat memasuki ruang MRI. Klinik tidak diberi tahu bahwa pendamping itu membawa senjata. Senjata tertarik oleh medan magnet MRI sehingga meletus tanpa sengaja. Peluru yang ditembakkan bersarang di punggung kanan bawah pendamping. Tidak ada orang lain yang cedera, termasuk pasien yang sedang menjalani pemeriksaan MRI. Pendamping yang cedera ditangani…
event_text: IT WAS REPORTED THAT A SERIOUS INJURY OCCURRED DURING NORMAL OPERATION AND PATIENT POSITIONING IN THE MAGNETOM AERA ROOM. THE PATIENT WAS ACCOMPANIED BY A MALE COMPANION WHO HAD ON HIS PERSON A LOADED GUN (PISTOL) AND AN EXTRA MAGAZINE WHEN ENTERING THE MAGNETIC RESONANCE IMAGING (MRI) ROOM. THE CLINIC WAS NOT INFORMED THAT THE COMPANION WAS CARRYING A WEAPON. THE WEAPON WAS ATTRACTED TO THE MAGNETIC FIELD OF THE MRI, RESULTING IN THE ACCIDENTAL FIRING OF THE WEAPON. THE DISCHARGED PROJECTILE (BULLET) LODGED IN THE LOWER RIGHT SIDE OF THE COMPANION'S BACK. THERE WAS NO INJURY TO OTHERS AT THE SCENE, INCLUDING THE PATIENT WHO WAS HAVING THE MRI EXAMINATION. THE INJURED COMPANION WAS ATTENDED

narasi_id: Dilaporkan bahwa seorang pasien dirawat karena luka bakar derajat satu dan lepuh di kedua lengan bawah setelah pemeriksaan toraks menggunakan koil CTL. Selama pemindaian, pasien diposisikan dengan kedua lengan terlipat di dada dan tangan saling bertaut. Bantalan yang sesuai tidak dipakai. Bagian keselamatan kerja di manual operator memperingatkan posisi seperti ini dan menjelaskan pemasangan bantalan pasien yang benar untuk mencegah pemanasan selama pemindaian MRI.
event_text: IT WAS REPORTED THAT A PATIENT WAS TREATED FOR FIRST-DEGREE BURNS AND BLISTERING ON BOTH FOREARMS FOLLOWING A THORACIC EXAM USING A CTL COIL. DURING THE SCAN, THE PATIENT HAD BEEN POSITIONED WITH BOTH ARMS FOLDED OVER THEIR CHEST WITH HANDS INTERLOCKED. APPROPRIATE PADDING WAS NOT USED. THE WORKING SAFETY SECTION OF THE OPERATOR'S MANUAL WARNS AGAINST THIS POSTIONING AND DEFINES PROPER PATIENT PADDING TO PREVENT WARMING DURING MRI SCANS.

label: Malfunction
narasi_id: Dilaporkan bahwa seorang teknisi lapangan (FE) menyentuh pipa ventilasi kriogen horizontal saat magnet diturunkan (ramp down). Selama prosedur ini, magnet membuang gas kriogen sehingga pipa ventilasi menjadi sangat dingin. Teknisi tersebut mengalami luka bakar berlepuh tepat di bawah lutut. Teknisi itu sudah dilatih prosedur servis magnet dan tahu bahwa pipa ventilasi akan menjadi sangat dingin.
event_text: IT WAS REPORTED THAT A FIELD ENGINEER (FE) CONTACTED THE HORIZONTAL CRYOGEN VENT PIPE DURING RAMP DOWN OF THE MAGNET. DURING THIS PROCEDURE, THE MAGNET VENTS CRYOGENS MAKING THE VENT EXTREMELY COLD. THE FE RECEIVED A BLISTER BURN TO THE AREA JUST BELOW THE KNEE. THE FE WAS TRAINED IN THE SERVICE PROCEDURES OF THE MAGNET KNOWING THE VENT WOULD GET EXTREMELY COLD.

narasi_id: Pada (B)(6) 2022, FUJIFILM Healthcare Americas Corporation menerima keluhan tentang sistem MRI terbuka Oasis XP 1.2T. Pelanggan mengeluhkan mutu pencitraan payudara. Fasilitas melaporkan perbedaan ukuran lesi: 75 mm pada sistem non-Fujifilm (pemindaian (B)(6) 2022) tetapi hanya 5 mm pada sistem MRI terbuka Oasis XP 1.2T (pemindaian (B)(6) 2022). event_text: ON (B)(6) 2022 FUJIFILM HEALTHCARE AMERICAS CORPORATION RECEIVED A COMPLAINT REGARDING OASIS XP 1.2T OPEN MRI SYSTEM. THE CUSTOMER COMPLAINED ABOUT THE QUALITY OF BREAST IMAGING. THE PATIENT IS A KNOWN BREAST CANCER PATIENT AND IS ACTIVELY UNDERGOING TREATMENT. THE SITE REPORTED THE DISCREPANCY IN THE SIZE OF A LESION THAT WAS 75 MM ON A NON-FUJIFILM SYSTEM (SCAN WAS DONE ON (B)(6) 2022) VS ONLY 5 MM ON THE OASIS XP 1.2T OPEN MRI SYSTEM (SCAN WAS DONE ON (B)(6) 2022). THERE IS NO DEATH OR SERIOUS INJURY ASSOCIATED WITH EVENT. AS SUCH, THIS IS BEING SUBMITTED IN AN ABUNDANCE OF CAUTION.

narasi_id: Pelanggan menelepon teknisi Canon untuk melaporkan kebakaran di ruang peralatan yang melibatkan konektor Hubbell pada jalur daya kompresor pendingin. Asap hitam dan api dilaporkan. Pelanggan masuk ke ruang peralatan dan segera mematikan beberapa pemutus PCDU serta pemutus panel dinding utama untuk memutus daya dari sistem, sehingga api padam. event_text: CUSTOMER CALLED CANON CUSTOMER ENGINEER TO REPORT A FIRE IN THE EQUIPMENT ROOM INVOLVING A HUBBELL CONNECTOR IN THE REFRIGERATOR COMPRESSOR POWER LINE. BLACK SMOKE AND FLAMES WERE REPORTED. THE CUSTOMER ENTERED THE EQUIPMENT ROOM AND QUICKLY FLIPPED OFF SEVERAL PCDU BREAKERS AS WELL AS A MAIN WALL PANEL BREAKER TO REMOVE POWER FROM THE SYSTEM, WHICH PUT OUT THE FLAMES. WHEN THE CANON CUSTOMER ENGINEER ARRIVED ON-SITE, HE DISCOVERED THAT A HUBBELL CONNECTOR THAT HAD BEEN INSERTED IN THE POWER LINE TO THE COMPRESSOR WAS MELTED AND BURNED. UPON INSPECTION, BURN MARKS WERE PRESENT ON THE WALL AND FLOOR PANEL NEAR WHERE THE HUBBELL CONNECTOR WAS SITTING. THE HUBBELL CONNECTOR WAS NOT A MANUFACTUR

narasi_id: Selama pemindaian MRI, pasien mengeluhkan suara keras di telinga kanannya. Kami memeriksanya dan mendapati sumbat telinga yang lebih besar hampir sepenuhnya masuk ke telinganya. event_text: DURING THE MRI SCAN THE PATIENT COMPLAINED ABOUT LOUD NOISE FROM HIS RIGHT EAR. WE CHECKED ON HIM AND FOUND THE LARGER EAR PLUG WAS IN HIS EAR ALMOST ALL THE WAY. event_text: PATIENT CAME OUT OF SCANNER AND COMMENTED THAT HER FINGERS HAD BURNS.  THE PATIENT HAD RINGS ON BOTH "PINKY FINGERS" DURING THE SCAN.  BURNS WERE NOTED AS 3RD DEGREE, SMALL, BUT DEEP.  BURNS WERE ON A FINGER WITH A RING AND ON THE THUMB.  PATIENT WAS BELIEVED TO HAVE BEEN POSITIONED WITH HANDS TOGETHER IN ISOCENTER OF THE MRI, BUT PATIENT CANNOT REMEMBER EXACT LOCATION OF HANDS DUE TO BEING SEDATED.  PATIENT WAS TREATED IN THE ED WITH DRESSINGS AND BACITRACIN. PATIENT WAS CARED FOR BY MDS ON SITE, THEN TRANSFERRED VIA MONITORED AMBULANCE TO ED FOR CARDIOLOGIST CARE. WAS DISCHARGED LATER SAME DAY TO HOME.

narasi_id: Seorang pasien mengalami luka bakar di bagian belakang lengan bawah kanan dekat siku selama pemindaian. Pasien menjalani pemindaian badan dan diposisikan dengan lengan di atas kepala. Pada posisi ini, lengan pasien di dekat siku menyentuh bore magnet karena tidak dipakai bantalan untuk mencegah kontak. Manual operator memperingatkan kontak semacam ini dan memberi tahu operator bahwa kontak tersebut dapat menyebabkan luka bakar.
event_text: A PATIENT WAS BURNED TO THE POSTERIOR OF THE RIGHT FOREARM IN THE AREA OF THE ELBOW, DURING A SCAN. THE PATIENT HAD A TORSO SCAN AND WAS POSITIONED IN THE SCANNER WITH THE ARMS ABOVE THE HEAD. IN THIS POSITION THE PATIENT'S ARMS NEAR ELBOWS WERE CONTACTING THE BORE OF THE MAGNET BECAUSE NO PADDING WAS USED DURING THE SCAN TO PREVENT THIS CONTACT. THE OPERATOR'S MANUAL WARNS AGAINST THIS CONTACT AND ALSO INFORMS THE OPERATOR THAT BURNS COULD BE THE RESULT OF THIS CONTACT.

narasi_id: GE Medical Systems menerima laporan bahwa seorang pasien mengalami luka bakar derajat dua kecil di sisi lututnya akibat koil permukaan lutut khusus penerima. event_text: IT WAS REPORTED TO GE MEDICAL SYSTEMS THAT A PT RECEIVED A SMALL SECOND DEGREE BURN ON THE SIDE OF HER KNEE FROM A RECEIVE ONLY KNEE SURFACE COIL. narasi_id: Pada 30 Desember 2021, FUJIFILM Healthcare Americas Corporation diberi tahu tentang insiden terkait pemindaian MRI yang mungkin menyebabkan salah diagnosis. event_text: ON DECEMBER 30, 2021 FUJIFILM HEALTHCARE AMERICAS CORPORATION WAS INFORMED OF AN INCIDENT RELATED TO MRI SCANS POSSIBLY LEADING TO MISDIAGNOSIS. narasi_id: Seorang pasien dipindai dengan lead EKG terpasang selama pemindaian. Lead EKG tidak diberi bantalan agar terpisah dari kulit pasien. Tenaga kesehatan juga memakai lead EKG yang kemasannya bertanda tidak kompatibel dengan MR. Pasien mengalami luka bakar derajat satu di area dada akibat lead EKG, serta luka bakar derajat dua di tempat salah satu elektroda EKG ditempelkan di dada. Luka bakar derajat dua ini memiliki lepuh seukuran koin 25 sen. Peringatan di manual operator tentang bantalan, lead EKG, dan perangkat yang kompatibel dengan MR tidak diikuti.
event_text: A PATIENT WAS SCANNED AND HAD ECG LEADS ATTACHED DURING THE SCAN. THE ECG LEADS WERE NOT PADDED TO KEEP THEM AWAY FROM THE PATIENT'S SKIN DURING THE SCAN. THE HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONAL ALSO USED ECG LEADS THAT WERE MARKED ON THE PACKAGING TO BE NOT MR COMPATIBLE. THE PATIENT HAD FIRST DEGREE BURNS TO THE CHEST AREA FROM THE ECG LEADS AND THE PATIENT ALSO HAD A SECOND DEGREE BURN WHERE ONE OF THE ECG ELECTRODES WAS ATTACHED TO THE CHEST. THIS SECOND DEGREE BURN HAD A BLISTER THE SIZE OF A QUARTER. THE WARNINGS IN THE OPERATOR'S MANUAL COVER PADDING, ECG LEADS, AND MR COMPATIBLE DEVICES WHICH WERE NOT FOLLOWED.

label: Malfunction
narasi_id: Dilaporkan bahwa empat pasien mengalami luka bakar serius akibat lead EKG saat menjalani pemindaian. Semua pasien dalam sedasi selama pemindaian. Pasien tidak diberi bantalan untuk menjauhkan lead EKG dari kulit, dan lead EKG yang tidak disetujui untuk MR dipakai selama pemindaian. Manual operator menyatakan bahwa hanya lead EKG yang disetujui untuk MR yang boleh dipakai di pemindai MR, bantalan wajib dipakai untuk menjauhkan lead dari kulit pasien, dan pasien berisiko tinggi yang tersedasi harus dipantau ketat selama pemindaian.
event_text: IT WAS REPORTED THAT FOUR PATIENTS RECEIVED SERIOUS BURNS FROM ECG LEADS WHILE HAVING SCANS. THE PATIENTS WERE ALL SEDATED DURING THE SCANS. THE PATIENTS WERE NOT PADDED TO KEEP THE ECG LEADS AWAY FROM THE PATIENTS SKIN AND NON-MR APPROVED ECG LEADS WERE USED DURING THE SCANS. THE OPERATOR MANUAL STATES THAT ONLY MR APPROVED ECG LEADS ARE TO BE USED IN MR SCANNERS, PADDING MUST BE USED TO KEEP THE LEADS AWAY FROM THE PATIENT'S SKIN, AND THAT HIGH-RISK PATIENTS, UNDER SEDATION, NEED TO BE CLOSELY  MONITORED DURING SCANS.

narasi_id: Pada 22/07/2025, FUJIFILM Corporation diberi tahu tentang kejadian yang melibatkan Echelon. Selama pemeriksaan di Echelon dengan koil badan RAPID, pasien mengalami luka bakar. Pasien mengalami kemerahan dan lepuh, dan menolak kompres es. Bantalan 1/4 inci tidak dipakai di antara koil dan pasien sebagaimana diatur dalam rencana pencegahan pemanasan pasien MR Fujifilm. event_text: ON 07/22/2025, FUJIFILM CORPORATION WAS INFORMED OF AN EVENT INVOLVING ECHELON. DURING AN EXAM ON THE ECHELON USING RABID BODY COIL, THE PATIENT EXPERIENCED A BURN. THE PATIENT WAS WEARING SCRUB SHORTS. THE COIL WAS PLACED DIRECTLY ON THE PATIENT, RESULTING IN SKIN-TO-COIL CONTACT AT THE FEMUR. THE PATIENT SHOWED REDNESS AND A BLISTER AND DECLINED AN ICE PACK. 1/4" PADDING WAS NOT USED BETWEEN THE COIL AND THE PATIENT, AS OUTLINED IN FUJIFILM MR PATIENT WARMING PREVENTION PLAN. THE TECHNOLOGIST REMOVED THE PATIENT FROM THE MACHINE, PLACED PADDING BETWEEN THE COIL AND THE PATIENT'S LEGS, AND COMPLETED THE EXAM WITHOUT FURTHER PROBLEM.

narasi_id: Siemens Healthineers mengetahui insiden pasien yang melibatkan sistem MAGNETOM Symphony A Tim. event_text: SIEMENS HEALTHINEERS BECAME AWARE OF A PATIENT INCIDENT INVOLVING THE MAGNETOM SYMPHONY A TIM SYSTEM. THE PERFUSORS WERE ATTRACTED BY THE MAGNET AND ENDED UP ON THE SIDE OF THE FRONT COVER. THE IMPACT DAMAGED THE PERFUSORS, SO THE NECESSARY MEDICATION WAS NOT ADMINISTERED. IT IS UNKNOWN, AS OF THE DATE OF THIS REPORT, IF THIS EVENT MAY HAVE CONTRIBUTED TO THE PATIENT'S DEATH SHORTLY AFTER THE INCIDENT.

narasi_id: Pada 10 Januari 2022, FUJIFILM Healthcare Corporation diberi tahu tentang insiden terkait sistem MRI Oasis. event_text: ON 10 JANUARY 2022, FUJIFILM HEALTHCARE CORPORATION WAS INFORMED OF AN INCIDENT RELATED TO OASIS MRI SYSTEM. AS THE TECHNICIAN BACKED THE WHEEL CHAIR INTO THE ROOM, WHEELCHAIR WAS PULLED IN BY THE MAGNET. SHE HAD THE BREATH KNOCKED OUT OF HER AND WAS PINNED BY HER HAND BUT WAS ABLE TO GET FREE. THE TECHNICIAN HAD TO GO TO URGENT CARE FOR MINOR INJURIES. SHE HAD A SPRAINED THUMB, BRUISED SHOULDER, AND TWISTED HER KNEE. narasi_id: Pada 22/07/2025, FUJIFILM Corporation diberi tahu tentang kejadian yang melibatkan Echelon. Selama pemeriksaan di Echelon dengan koil badan RAPID, pasien mengalami luka bakar. event_text: ON 07/22/2025, FUJIFILM CORPORATION WAS INFORMED OF AN EVENT INVOLVING ECHELON DURING AN EXAM ON THE ECHELON USING RABID BODY COIL, THE PATIENT EXPERIENCED A BURN. event_text: PT WAS BEING IMAGED IN A 15T GE SIGNA MR SYSTEM, SOFTWARE REV 5.6 ADVANTAGE PLATFORM. PT WAS FEET FIRST IN THE MAGNET WITH THE TORSO ARRAY COIL AROUND THEIR PELVIS. event_text: IT WAS REPORTED THAT A PATIENT SUSTAINED AN INJURY TO THE HEAD THAT REQUIRED A STITCH TO CLOSE. THE SITE HAD WARNING SIGNS AT ENTRANCES TO THE MAGNET ROOM WARNING OF THE MAGNETIC FIELD. HEALTH CARE PROFESSIONALS ARE ALL TRAINED ON THE DANGERS OF THE MAGNET FIELD. THE SCISSORS WERE NEVER CHECKED FOR FERROUS CONTENT. THE SIGNS, TRAINING AND CHECKING ARE ALL SPECIFIED IN THE OPERATOR'S MANUAL.

event_text: HEATING OF AUDIO SYSTEM. WE HAD BEEN NOTIFIED OF AN INCIDENT WHERE THE CABLE OF THE NNL HEADPHONE HEATED DURING AN EXAMINATION. IT WAS REPORTED THAT AFTER A PATIENT SCAN, THE OPERATOR IDENTIFIED THAT THE HEADPHONE CABLE HAD BECOME HEATED. NO INJURY WAS REPORTED TO THE PATIENT OR THE OPERATOR. HOWEVER, IT WAS REPORTED THE CABLE WAS SUFFICIENTLY HEATED TO BECOME UNCOMFORTABLE TO TOUCH, WITH THE POTENTIAL TO CAUSE INJURY. THE NNL AUDIOSYSTEM IN QUESTION, HAD HAD A MODIFIED HEADPHONE (A SET OF RESISTORS LOCATED AT THE CONNECTOR OF THE HEADPHONE CABLE). THE INCIDENT OCCURRED ON THE 1.5T SCANNER (PHILIPS) DURING A SPINE EXAMINATION IN A HOSPITAL IN (B)(6).

narasi_id: Selama pemeriksaan MRI, unit MRI berhenti bekerja. event_text: DURING AN MRI EXAMINATION, THE MRI UNIT STOPPED WORKING, WHEN THE TECHNOLOGIST ENTERED THE SCAN ROOM TO SEE WHAT WAS WRONG, THEY SMELLED SMOKE AND SAW SMOKE AND POSSIBLE FLAMES IN A CLOSET BEHIND THE SCANNER THAT HOUSES THE PASS THROUGH FILTER FROM THE EQUIPMENT ROOM INTO THE SCAN ROOM. THE TECHNOLOGIST IMMEDIATELY REMOVED THE PT FROM THE ROOM (WITHOUT INCIDENT) AND INSTRUCTED OTHERS IN THE AREA THERE WAS A FIRE, TO PULL THE ALARM AND EVACUATE ALL PTS. THE TECHNOLOGIST THEN WENT BACK WITH AN MRI SAFE FIRE EXTINGUISHER AND EXTINGUISHED THE SMALL FIRE. THERE WERE NO INJURIES REPORTED. FIRE DEPARTMENT ARRIVED AND VERIFIED THE FIRE HAD BEEN FULLY EXTINGUISHED.

narasi_id: Seorang teknisi Siemens melaporkan bahwa teknisi MRI di rumah sakit melihat api di bagian belakang bore magnet sistem MRI saat memindai pasien.
